extra_quotes: Utilizing a real-space Wannier basis, our formulation treats the electronic structure [27], electron-phonon coupling [28, 29], and nonlinear optical responses [30, 31] on an equal footing.

Note that here we do not consider the relaxation of atom positions under strain gradient (i.e., the clamped-ion approximation), so that all atoms within a unit cell follow the same displacement field.
In the present implementation, we introduce a phenomenological electron linewidthζ= 20 meV to regularize the numerical divergence whenϵ nk ≈ϵ m,k+q.
